versions.changelog:
- Skill name updated to “feishu-pro-testcase-generation” and description rewritten for broader, expert-level testcase generation coverage.
- Legacy agents and reference files removed for a cleaner, more streamlined skill package.
- SKILL.md fully rewritten: now focused on professional, practical, and executable testcase design directly based on detailed user input—not just Feishu doc links.
- Output requirements clarified: modular tables in Markdown, with explicit testcase/scene structures, precise step/result language, and priority coding (P0–P3).
- Enhanced workflow: covers requirement intake, scenario/step decomposition, and clear ambiguity confirmation tables.
- Tool and output rules detailed; tool use only if supported in the environment, else output is plain Markdown by default.

Initial release of Feishu Testcase Writer.

- Converts Feishu/Lark requirement document links into structured, review-ready QA testcase docs in the team's approved style.
- Automatically decomposes modules and business rules into hierarchical testcases, covering list/detail pages, field rules, status flows, calculations, and permissions.
- Discovers available Feishu tools for online doc reading and cloud doc writing; offers fallback to Markdown if tools are unavailable.
- Ensures all testcases include placeholders for evidence and open questions, without fabricating results or data.
- Outputs documents with stable headings, explicit rule breakdowns, clear module separation, and compliance with reviewed document templates.
